roslaunch dependency check test looks in manifest.xml for dependency
The `roslaunch_add_file_check` macro complains about missing dependency in manifest.xml file.  It's not clear if the script is looking for the manifest.xml file (in which case it would fail under catkin) or if the dependency is truly missing (which I don't think it is).

The following steps reproduce the problem:
1. Clone the repo:
   `git clone https://github.com/shaun-edwards/industrial_core.git`
   `git checkout rosi_issue_11_launch_test`
2. Make/run the tests:
   `catkin_make run_tests_industrial_robot_simulator`

Resulting output:

```

FAILURE:
[/home/ros/ros/release/src/industrial_core/industrial_robot_simulator/launch/robot_interface_simulator.launch]:

wrote test file to [/home/ros/ros/release/build/test_results/industrial_robot_simulator/roslaunch-check_launch.xml]
-- run_tests.py: verify result "/home/ros/ros/release/build/test_results/industrial_robot_simulator/roslaunch-check_launch.xml"
```

The test was added to CMakeLists.txt:

```
<snip>
find_package(roslaunch)
roslaunch_add_file_check(launch)
<snip>
```

The package xml has the following depends:

```
<build_depend>industrial_robot_client</build_depend>
<run_depend>industrial_robot_client</run_depend>
```

This appears to be a bug in the roslaunch test macros.
</issue>

42| namespace ros
43| {
44| 
45| /**
46|  * \brief Abstract interface for items which can be added to a CallbackQueueInterface
47|  */
48| class ROSCPP_DECL CallbackInterface
49| {
50| public:
51|   /**
52|    * \brief Possible results for the call() method
53|    */
54|   enum CallResult
55|   {
56|     Success,   ///< Call succeeded
57|     TryAgain,  ///< Call not ready, try again later
58|     Invalid,   ///< Call no longer valid
59|   };
60| 
61|   virtual ~CallbackInterface() {}
62| 
63|   /**
64|    * \brief Call this callback
65|    * \return The result of the call
66|    */
67|   virtual CallResult call() = 0;
68|   /**
69|    * \brief Provides the opportunity for specifying that a callback is not ready to be called
70|    * before call() actually takes place.
71|    */
72|   virtual bool ready() { return true; }
73| };
74| typedef boost::shared_ptr<CallbackInterface> CallbackInterfacePtr;
75| 
76| /**
77|  * \brief Abstract interface for a queue used to handle all callbacks within roscpp.
78|  *
79|  * Allows you to inherit and provide your own implementation that can be used instead of our
80|  * default CallbackQueue
81|  */
82| class CallbackQueueInterface
83| {
84| public:
85|   virtual ~CallbackQueueInterface() {}
86| 
87|   /**
88|    * \brief Add a callback, with an optional owner id.  The owner id can be used to
89|    * remove a set of callbacks from this queue.
90|    */
91|   virtual void addCallback(const CallbackInterfacePtr& callback, uint64_t owner_id = 0) = 0;
92| 
93|   /**
94|    * \brief Remove all callbacks associated with an owner id
95|    */
96|   virtual void removeByID(uint64_t owner_id) = 0;
97| };
